text:
maria: Heads-up: hosted-us-west p95 jumped from ~120ms -> ~850ms and p99 to ~2.1s around 18:02 UTC. Alerting and customer rate alarms firing.

ajay_oncall: seeing the same in grafana. queue_depth for the api-worker pool spiked from 2 -> 45. throughput flat, so looks like backlog not burst traffic.

sam_k: on it. I pulled recent kernel-selector logs and there's a flurry of kernel_fallback events around the spike window. Also batch sizes dropped — median batch_size went from 6 -> 1.8.

charlie: small batches + kernel_fallback is a nasty combo. If coalesce/sampler produced tiny batches the kernel selection heuristics might prefer the aux (slower) path. Any kvcache churn?

maria: kvcache eviction rate increased 8x during spike window, prefix-hit-rate dipped from 94% -> 63%.

ajay_oncall: cpu profiles from the runtime show increased descheduling in the scheduling loop. attaching query: ```promql
rate(runtime_queue_depth[1m])
```

sam_k: quick dump of kernel-selector metric (trimmed): ```
kernel_choice_total{type="primary"} 12000
kernel_choice_total{type="aux"} 7800
kernel_fallback_events_total 430
``` fallback events line up with p99 bursts.

charlie: hypothesis: recent sampler tweak (staggered-sampler v2) reduced per-slot accumulation so batching falls apart under certain request spacing -> more small batches -> more KV cache misses (less prefix reuse) -> kernel heuristic sees shorter sequences and selects aux/compat kernels -> higher latency per token.

maria: @sam_k is staggered-sampler v2 rolled to hosted-us-west? deploy-bot shows a config push at 17:58.

infra-bot: config-change: sampler.staggered_v2 enabled in cluster hosted-us-west at 2024-11-23T17:58:12Z by infra-release.

ajay_oncall: ok. Repro path: run synthetic traffic with interarrival jitter similar to customer mix (bursty-short prompts) and compare batch_hist.

sam_k: running local repro now. Quick mitigation: revert sampler toggle or bump coalesce window from 10ms -> 40ms. Reverting if needed.

charlie: also recommend temporary kernel-selector policy to prefer primary kernel for 1s window when queue_depth > 8 (fast fallback to reduce p99).

maria: agreed. action items: 1) sam_k revert sampler toggle if repro shows. 2) charlie add temporary kernel-selector override. 3) ajay throttle rollout and notify customers. 4) collect flamegraphs and kvcache metrics for 30m.

sam_k: starting rollback now (patch queued). will post status.

ajay_oncall: notifying incident channel and customers with note: "brief performance regression being investigated; mitigation in progress" :warning:

maria: thanks. keep replies inline. once we have postmortem we should link the sampler PR that changed accumulation logic and the kernel heuristics doc.

sam_k: rollback applied at 18:06 UTC, kernel-selector override in flight. preliminary metrics showing median batch_size recovering to ~5 within 90s. p95 back to ~150ms after 3m.

charlie: collecting flamegraph now, will attach in follow-up. early look shows scheduler spin waiting on coalescer wakeups during spike.

maria: great. leaving this thread open until postmortem drafts. tagging folks for follow-ups: @charlie (flamegraphs), @sam_k (sampler revert PR), @ajay_oncall (customer comms).

infra-bot: incident_status: mitigated -> monitoring.

maria: closing notes: root cause likely interaction between staggered-sampler v2 and kernel selection heuristics exposing a workload that produces small batches and kvcache thrash. long-term fixes: sampler tuning, stronger kernel-choice smoothing, and conservative default coalesce windows. follow-up postmortem will have graphs and perf diffs. :white_check_mark:
